notes.title: Wishlist Silicone Heart now!
notes.content:
[b]Silicone Heart is now on Steam!
[/b]
Hey everyone! We're thrilled to announce that our game Silicone Heart is now available to wishlist on Steam!

🎮 Why does it matter?
Your support will help our studio take the next step and bring the game's release closer to reality!

In Silicone Heart, you'll find yourself on a scrapyard planet ruled by robots 🤖:
- Pretend to be a robot to survive.
- Grow vegetables and trade them for "energy," the local currency.
- Become a mechanic-healer, repairing robots from scattered parts.

Each repaired robot brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of the planet.

[b][u] Support us — wishlist the game now! [/u][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340880/Silicone_Heart/

notes.title: 🚀 Big update!
notes.content:
The big update that our team has been working on is already in styme! Update the game and come in to play.

What's new:

2 new maps at once!

1. Cyber Future
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/102ee0ac5dc8e95494d905cdcbd991498595f377.gif[/img]

- New laser mechanics. Dodge the laser. If you don't make it, you teleport back.

- Cyberpunk style location: neon signs, big skyscrapers. Climb to the top.

2. Airplane
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/7c3a42f7c47584f85385da000441b4aee2824650.gif[/img]

- The new mechanic is a winch. Cling alone or with another player to the bar. And unhook when you need to.

- A map with a lot of free space: jump, fly up, fly forward. The main thing - overtake everyone and get to the finish line first.

And the cool innovation is character customization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/0d0fabd1d3c16b82f64c20f11a5a0f3e3a1628bb.gif[/img]

Make your character unique. Distinguish yourself from other participants of the race. Stand out)

Your friend doesn't have a PC and can't buy the game on Steam? 

Give him a link to the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.garden.of.dreams.only.up.flip.master.parkour.pvp.lava.multiplayer.jumping.game]mobile version of Up or Lava on Google Play[/url].

Completing our levels on your phone is a challenge. Are you ready for it?

Have a great game!
Further - only up. There's lava at the bottom!

notes.title: New maps and customization!
notes.content:
Soon there will be a lot of new content in the game!

Our approach: new map - new mechanics.

We have 4 new maps coming up:
1. Cyber Punk
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/102ee0ac5dc8e95494d905cdcbd991498595f377.gif[/img]

A map that has collected all the best parkour mechanics from other maps. And a new mechanic - lasers!

Lasers will not give you a chance to relax for a minute! If you want to get to the finish line, you'll have to do your best.

2. Airplane.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/7c3a42f7c47584f85385da000441b4aee2824650.gif[/img]

Airplane - a map in the air with a lot of places where you can go into free fall... Into the lava!

New mechanics of the map - the ability to cling to the winch, which will throw you far ahead.

3. Arcade Machine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493157/4485b8f493f193c297cdbcec760a7accb262cfcf.jpg[/img]

You will get into a real huge arcade machine! And more than one.

New mechanics in development. We'll announce it in the next post.

4. Run and Fun NEW

A new map for those who like to tickle their nerves.

Run and Fun is a set of traps and obstacles for the most experienced players Up or Lava! 

Run and Fun 3 will bring together new mechanics from the update and will be especially challenging.

You will love it!

In addition to these:
1. Character customization!

2. Release of the game on Google Play.

3. And a bunch of fixed little things and bugs that we found with your help.

Our main priority is to increase one-time online in the game. Without it, it's hard to get an awesome competitive experience.

For this purpose we are releasing the game on all possible platforms.

The big update is coming this week! Stay tuned for it!

What would you like to see in the game?
